module oneshot (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  pulse,
    output reg pulse_p1
);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            pulse_p1 <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            pulse_p1 <= pulse;
        end
    end
endmodule
